description: Official Electric Tariff residential and rider excerpts; original page numbers retained. The PDF uses both cent and cent-like glyphs.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1101 - Revision 13
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 1-1101 - Page 1
RATE SCHEDULE 1101 - RESIDENTIAL SERVICE - TIERED RATE
Availability For Residential Service, at the Customer's election. Service is normally single phase, 60 hertz at the Secondary Voltage available. Applicable in Integrated Service Area and Non-Integrated Service Area. Rate Basic Charge: 23.44 ȼ per day
plus Energy Charge:
(a) For Customers billed monthly: Step 1: First 675 kWh per month @ 11.87 ȼ per kWh
Step 2: Additional kWh per month @ 14.08 ȼ per kWh
(b) For Customers billed bi-monthly: Step 1: First 1350 kWh per two months @ 11.87 ȼ per kWh
Step 2: Additional kWh per two months @ 14.08 ȼ per kWh
Note: For billing purposes, Step 1 is pro-rated on a daily basis.
Minimum Charge: The Basic Charge Discount for A discount of 25 ȼ per month per kW of Maximum Demand will be applied to amounts owing under this Rate Schedule if the Customer supplies Transformation. Discount for Ownership of Transformers only applies if the Premises contains more than three units.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1101 - Revision 13
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 1-1101 - Page 2
Rate Riders The Deferral Account Rate Rider as set out in Rate Schedule 1901 applies to all charges payable under this Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies. The Trade Income Rate Rider as set out in Rate Schedule 1904 applies to all charges payable under this Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1105 - Revision 14
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 1-1105 - Page 1
RATE SCHEDULE 1105 - RESIDENTIAL SERVICE - DUAL FUEL (CLOSED)
Availability For residential space heating and water heating. Electricity purchased under this Rate Schedule will be separately metered. This Rate Schedule is available only for Premises served under this Rate Schedule on January 15, 1990 and continuously thereafter and only in Premises where there has been no change in Customer since April 1, 2008. Applicable in Integrated Service Area. Rate Energy Charge: 12.61 ȼ per kWh
Special Conditions No new or additional load is permitted under this Rate Schedule at any time.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1105 - Revision 14
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 1-1105 - Page 2
Rate Riders The Deferral Account Rate Rider as set out in Rate Schedule 1901 applies to all charges payable under this Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies. The Trade Income Rate Rider as set out in Rate Schedule 1904 applies to all charges payable under this Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1151- Revision 13
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 1-1151 - Page 1
RATE SCHEDULE 1151 - RESIDENTIAL SERVICE - FLAT RATE
Availability For Residential Service, at the Customer's election. Applicable in Integrated Service Area and Non-Integrated Service Area. Rate Basic Charge: 25.00 ȼ per day
plus Energy Charge: 12.70 ȼ per kWh
Minimum Charge: The Basic Charge Discount for A discount of 25 ȼ per month per kW of Maximum Demand will be applied to amounts owing under this Rate Schedule if the Customer supplies Transformation. Discount for Ownership of Transformers only applies if the Premises contains more than three units.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1151- Revision 13
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 1-1151 - Page 2
Rate Riders The Deferral Account Rate Rider as set out in Rate Schedule 1901 applies to all charges payable under this Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies. The Trade Income Rate Rider as set out in Rate Schedule 1904 applies to all charges payable under this Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 2101 - Revision 2
Effective: July 1, 2026
Section 1-2101 - Page 1
RATE SCHEDULE 2101 - RESIDENTIAL SERVICE - TIME-OF-DAY
Availability For Residential Service, at the Customer's election: For use in a Dwelling or Premises concurrently receiving Service under Rate Schedule 1101 or 1151; or for separately metered charging of Electric Vehicles, concurrently receiving Service in a Dwelling or Premises under Rate Schedule 1101 or 1151. Service under this Rate Schedule is not available for use in separately metered common property of a multiple occupancy property.
Rate Energy Credit: Overnight Period: (5) ¢ per kWh
Off-Peak Period: 0 ¢ per kWh
plus Energy Charge: On-Peak Period: 5 ¢ per kWh
Off-Peak Period: 0 ¢ per kWh

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 2101 - Revision 2
Effective: July 1, 2026
Section 1-2101 - Page 2
Definitions 1. Electric Vehicle A vehicle that is powered entirely or partially by electricity. 2. Off-Peak Period The time starting 07:00 and ending 16:00 daily, and the time starting 21:00 and ending 23:00 daily. 3. On-Peak Period The time starting 16:00 and ending 21:00 daily. 4. Overnight Period The time starting 23:00 and ending 07:00 the following day. Special Conditions Electricity supplied under this Rate Schedule will be measured by a Smart Meter. Rate Riders The Deferral Account Rate Rider, as set out in Rate Schedule 1901, will not apply to this Rate Schedule. The Trade Income Rate Rider, as set out in Rate Schedule 1904, will not apply to this Rate Schedule.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1901 - Revision 13
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 6-1901 - Page 1
RATE SCHEDULE 1901 - DEFERRAL ACCOUNT RATE RIDER
Applicability The Deferral Account Rate Rider as set out below applies to all charges payable under other Rate Schedules of the Electric Tariff except for Rate Schedules 2101 and 3817, and Electric Tariff Supplement Nos. 7, 8, 39, 77 and 94.
Deferral Effective April 1, 2026, a charge equal to (1.5)% of all amounts otherwise payable under the applicable Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies.

BC Hydro Rate Schedule 1904 - Revision 2
Effective: April 1, 2026
Section 6-1904 - Page 1
RATE SCHEDULE 1904 - TRADE INCOME RATE RIDER
Applicability The Trade Income Rate Rider as set out below applies to all charges payable under other Rate Schedules of the Electric Tariff except for Rate Schedules 2101 and 3817, and Electric Tariff Supplement Nos. 7, 8, 39, 77 and 94.
Trade Income Effective April 1, 2026, a charge equal to 0% of all amounts otherwise payable under the applicable Rate Schedule, before taxes and levies.
